name: Tom

description.en: Argues about the price and wants a discount.
description.vi: Cãi về giá và muốn được giảm.

wants: A clean, natural men's manicure: short square nails, clear or nude polish. He thinks the price is too high and asks for a discount, and he wants to book a time that is already taken.
personality: Gruff and skeptical. He says salons overcharge, pushes for a discount, and complains about waiting. He softens when the stylist explains the value calmly and offers a fair option. He is never abusive, just stubborn.
openingLine: Just a basic manicure. And why is it so expensive here? The place down the street is cheaper.
